adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff, MultiEmail.tsx imports from '@calcom/ui' which is the package's public API. The file MultiEmail.tsx is then exported through MultiEmailLazy.tsx and index.tsx. This is a standard pattern in monorepos where internal components import from the package's barrel export. The claim of circular dependency is not verifiable from this diff - the import chain would be: MultiEmail imports primitives from @calcom/ui/index.tsx, and index.tsx imports MultiEmail through MultiEmailLazy. Modern bundlers handle this type of circular reference without issues, and this pattern is commonly used throughout the codebase (as seen with other lazy-loaded components like AddressInput and PhoneInput following the same pattern). The finding is speculative and not a verified defect.
